The ReefCloud reporting R package provides a collection of functions to extract and visualize information from the ReefCloud Public Dashboard (https://reefcloud.ai/dashboard/) and visualize them.

The tutorials provide code examples and detailed explanations to help users reproduce the visualisations.

## Setting up

The first step is to install the R package on your local machine by running the following code:

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, eval=FALSE}
remotes::install_github("ReefCloud/reefcloudreporting")
```
